name: Digital Product & Platform Delivery
summary: Carry an idea through discovery, design and engineering into software people can use and improve.
buyerProblem: A strategy becomes useful when it reaches a working system. We connect product decisions, user experience and implementation, with explicit scope, acceptance criteria and a plan for rollout.
deliverables: A defined problem, scope and user journey
A tested implementation and rollout plan
Handover, documentation and an improvement backlog
process: Define the users, problem and first useful release.
Design and build in reviewable increments.

faqs.question: Can we start with an existing project?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review the current product, code or delivery plan and discuss the work needed to move it forward.

faqs.question: Who owns the delivered work?
faqs.answer: Ownership, access, licensing and handover are agreed in the engagement scope before work starts. The website does not substitute for that agreement.
